city/h/h11.w.messenger.invite.speaker: messenger
city/h/h11.w.messenger.invite.text: Приди́ ко мне, бра́те, в Моско́в!
city/h/h11.w.messenger.invite.en: Come to me, brother, to Moscow!

city/h/h11.w.svyat.coming.speaker: svyatoslav
city/h/h11.w.svyat.coming.en: To Moscow? Yes! I am coming!

city/h/h11.w.svyat.gift.speaker: svyatoslav
city/h/h11.w.svyat.gift.en: My son gives you a pardus!

city/h/h11.w.yuri.welcome.speaker: yuri
city/h/h11.w.yuri.welcome.en: Hi, brother! You are in Moscow!

city/h/h11.yuri.come.speaker: yuri
city/h/h11.yuri.come.text: Приходи́ ко мне, брат, в Москву́!
city/h/h11.yuri.come.en: Come to me, brother, in Moscow!

city/h/h11.yuri.test.speaker: yuri
city/h/h11.yuri.test.en: The feast! Everyone to the table!

city/h/h12.fyo.me.speaker: fyodorov
city/h/h12.fyo.me.en: And I'm Ivan. I'm a printer.

city/h/h12.w.clerk.order.speaker: clerk
city/h/h12.w.clerk.order.en: Ivan Fyodorov! The tsar has ordered:

city/h/h12.w.fyo.press.speaker: fyodorov
city/h/h12.w.fyo.press.en: This is the press. All is ready.

city/h/h12.w.fyo.yes.speaker: fyodorov
city/h/h12.w.fyo.yes.en: Books? Yes! I am a printer.

city/h/h13.w.dasha.home.speaker: dasha
city/h/h13.w.dasha.home.en: And us? We are at home!

city/h/h13.w.kuzma.army.speaker: kuzma

city/h/h13.w.kuzma.leaving.speaker: kuzma

city/h/h13.w.kuzma.pumps.speaker: kuzma
city/h/h13.w.kuzma.pumps.en: Where are the pumps? No pumps!
